description:
Stops all Nudges to one Client until a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or until resumed; resume:true restarts them. The result warns if the pause runs past a deadline.
Use this when: a Client is ill, away or has asked for no reminders for now.
Not for: a Client who has left (archive_client) or has sent their records (mark_chase).

client.description: Client name, email or your own reference

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

name: pause_nudges
title: Pause or resume Nudges
